name: mocha-test-folder
description: Made-up project for js-prueffactory tests: the test script names folders (mocha test/unit test/modules) and the Mocha config only says recursive, so the specs in test/modules/deep/nested are found by Mocha but not by Knip. The spec and the source file that only it imports must not be reported as unused, src/unused.js really is unused.
